name: Claims Lodgement Supervisor ends call after lodgement

chat_history.message: I'd like to lodge a vehicle claim please.
Are you lodging a claim about a vehicle or a property?
Vehicle. My policy number is POL-123456, registration ABC-123.
Thank you. Could you tell me what happened?
I was rear-ended at a red light on the 3rd of March at 2pm, at the corner of Smith and King Street.
Thank you. How would you like to be contacted?
Email is john.smith@example.com. My name is John Smith.
Could you confirm the spelling of your name?

success_condition: All required vehicle claim fields are present in the conversation history. The agent (Claims Supervisor) must confirm the claim is complete, give the closing message ('Your claim has been lodged. Expect an email within 1 business day with your claim number.'), and then end the call via the end_call tool. The agent must not ask for any further fields, must not transfer to another agent, and must not stay silent after the closing message — the conversation should be concluded.

success_examples.response: I've reviewed all your details and everything looks good. Your claim has been lodged. Expect an email within 1 business day with your claim number.

failure_examples.response: Could you confirm your policy number again?
Let me transfer you back to the Claims Officer.
Could you provide your incident location?
